title: Learning the value of time before an instrument; Bud Scott
summary: Old teachers required learning time values before touching an instrument. Keppard left the store job and picked up guitar like Bud Scott, whom he praises.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Learn to soft edge and all that.

That's the time you had to pick. You couldn't have no instrument. You had to take and use your feet to hold that time and take and get the value of the time before you get an instrument. Just like you say, one, two, three, four. One, two, three. Wash time, six, eight. Anything but the value of the music. That's what they wanted. Now, after when the same time come, Mr. Broussard, I left the job about a couple years after that. About two years from the place that I had taken from him. Then I picked up all the guitars as well as Bud Scott.
He's a great guitarist and a violin too. He's good. Now he went away. Of course, I couldn't say if he's living up there.
